category: inference gateway, free plan behind a username-and-password account

free_tier.stated: Free plan, $0.00/month: 1 request per minute, 1 000 requests per day, free models only
free_tier.notes: GET /v1/models lists 783 ids; 29 carry tier free (6 operational, 1 degraded, 22 major_outage when read) and 754 carry tier paid

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; POST {base}/chat/completions. A GET to the route answers 405 with Allow: POST
chaining: pairs with an agent as a catalogue with a per-id status field; the Free plan rate of 1 request per minute is the scarce link

limits.value: 1 request per minute on the Free plan (a paid Starter plan is 20 per minute)
1 000 requests per day on the Free plan, free models only

binding_note: 1 request per minute binds long before 1 000 requests per day

identity_cost.detail: a free account with a username and a password: no email and no card required to start, and the API key is generated in the dashboard. The g4f.dev provider page states the free tier is available without an API key and its JavaScript example sends no Authorization header; a keyless completion was not exercised

reliability_note: the listing carries a status per id: 22 of the 29 ids with tier free read major_outage when the listing was fetched, so most free ids were not serving
confidence_note: the plan limits and the signup are first-party; the keyless claim is on the g4f.dev provider page and in a third-party router that lists the service as a keyless upstream. No completion was sent because probe issues GET and HEAD only

evidence.proved: the Free plan allows 1 request per minute
the Free plan allows 1 000 requests per day

evidence.quote: | Model access | Free models | All models | All models | All models | All models | All models |
evidence.proved: the Free plan is limited to free models

evidence.quote: Visit the signup page and create a free account with a username and password. No email or credit card required to start.
evidence.proved: signup needs a username and a password, no email and no card
